description: This Java interface defines a builder for creating responses to 'RetrieveAttributes' commands within the 'live' signals command framework in the Eclipse Ditto project. It specifies methods for generating attribute retrieval responses and error responses, used in handling live command responses in the system.

classes.name: RetrieveAttributesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: An interface for building responses to 'RetrieveAttributes' commands, extending a query command response step interface.

classes.name: RetrieveAttributesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: A nested interface defining factory methods to create response objects for 'RetrieveAttributes' command responses, including success and error responses.

methods.name: retrieved
methods.description: Creates a response containing the retrieved attributes, representing a successful response.

methods.name: attributesNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating that the attributes cannot be accessed, due to absence or permission issues.
